visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy dark hair, wearing a white crew-neck t-shirt, stands in front of a plain grey background. He holds a white rectangular box with an orange base, pointing his finger at the text on it while smiling at the lens. (2) He removes a sleek black eyeliner pen with a gold-colored cap from the box. He demonstrates the assembly of the pen by clicking the components together and then shakes the pen vigorously with a series of quick hand movements. (3) He draws two thin black lines on the back of his left hand, which has a solid black band tattoo. He then uses his finger to rub the lines forcefully, demonstrating the smudge-proof quality of the product. (4) A close-up shot focuses on his eye as he applies the eyeliner along his upper lash line. His movements are precise, and he maintains a calm, focused facial expression. (5) He holds the eyeliner pen vertically toward the camera to show the product clearly while continuing to speak and smile. The lighting is bright and uniform, highlighting the product and his face.
